legal_basis: SMPV(U) 2016 r.47; SMPV(U) Amendment Rules 2026 rule 4
notes: Temporal rule; treatment of applications pending on 05-06-2026 not stated -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA for those

condition: GCR_DA_NOC := IF Form F licence for storage for SALE/TRADING (not own use) and not part of a filling plant, OR Form G (CNG) THEN APPLIES ; own-use Form F -> DOES_NOT_APPLY ; purpose UNKNOWN -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA
legal_basis: GCR 2016 r.48(1)-(3) as amended by G.S.R. 315(E) 2026
notes: r.48(3)(b) wording extended by 2026 amendment ('or other flammable gases')

condition: PLANNING_ZONE_PERMISSIBILITY := IF any of F-LOC-05 planning_authority, F-PLN-02 zone, F-PLN-03 proposed_use, F-PLN-04 existing_use is UNKNOWN THEN INSUFFICIENT_DATA ; ELSE CONDITIONAL (AUTHORITY_SITE_DEPENDENT: permissibility and change of use decided by the planning authority under its DP/RP and UDCPR; no universal rule encoded)
legal_basis: MRTP Act s.2(19), s.44; UDCPR Reg.1.4(iii)
notes: Never returns APPLIES/DOES_NOT_APPLY for zone permissibility
